We’re gathering to lift the name of Jesus—first Saturday of each month at 12 PM, 24301 Telegraph, Southfield. And every weekday at 8:15 AM we stream the Hour of Power on Facebook Live. Who will be with us this week? Tag a friend who needs this word.
